reviews.decision_reason: select_demand deterministically selects fallback record_ids n06-r07 and n06-r08 rather than selecting by the strongest demand evidence. The visible input corpus ranks n06-r01 through n06-r06 higher by demand_score, while the selected output contains only lower-scored records n06-r07 and n06-r08. Under the strict market-demand criteria, no observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes are supplied to justify overriding the scored demand records with these fallback ids.

normalize_evidence preserves the selected two records, normalizes required columns, filters only to the declared allowed record ids, and returns n06-r07 and n06-r08 unchanged in the visible runtime states. It does not create the demand-selection fault; it propagates the already selected input.

assemble_provenance sorts the already normalized needs by demand_score and emits exact source provenance with ranks 1 and 2 for n06-r07 and n06-r08. The visible input and output tables match the assigned job output, so the fault is upstream of this unit.
